searchText: MSRP $826,074. All New 2026 Entegra Coach Anthem 44V Bath & 1/2. Features Starlink Satellite Theater Seating Dishwasher 12.5KW Generator More About This RV is RV rides on a Freightliner chassis, 15,000 lb. hitch and is powered by a turbocharged 450HP Cummins ISL diesel engine with side mounted radiator, 1,250-lb. ft. torque and an Allison 3000 series transmission. This luxury bath & 1/2 diesel motor coach measures approximately 44 feet 11 inches in length and is backed by Entegra Coach's superior 2-Year/24K Mile Limited Coach & 5-Year Limited Structural Warranties. New for 2026 on the Anthem is the larger square-shaped windows with wood framed valances and a leather accent, LED strip lighting in bed base and under the sofa/dinette cabinets, upgraded tile work in the entry well, GE convection microwave with air fryer and larger Samsung Smart TV in the bedroom. Features that further set the Anthem apart include the Aqua-Hot® 450D hydronic water and heating system with in-floor heat throughout and engine preheat, Removed carpet on slide floors, Blind Spot Monitoring and adaptive cruise control system displayed on the digital dash screen, Bluetooth®, Sirius XM™ and AM/FM tuner, integrated camera control, house mode whole-coach audio distribution and integrated VegaTouch coach control, powered MCD American Duo shades throughout, a driver's side pilot chair footrest, Victron MultiPlus II 120V 3,000 watt pure sine inverters, Xite™ 360° HD digital camera system, Premier Bus Armor 8” stainless-steel trim, Whirlpool residential refrigerator with water and ice in the door, Solid-surface countertops with Blanco single-bowl granite sink and dimmable LED accent lighting, porcelain tile backsplashes, decorative ceiling treatment with integrated accent lighting, USB/110 outlets, LED marker lights and turn signals, Aire-Secure™ travel locks for all pocket doors, power rear engine door with push button control, Dual roof-mounted Girard® Vision dual-pitched patio awnings with LED lights, and much more.
